svg.title: OBD2 K-Line Reader - open-source ESP32 and Arduino scan tool firmware for ISO 9141-2 and KWP2000
svg.desc: Banner showing the web dashboard of the OBD2 K-Line Reader on two phones, the main menu and live engine data, next to the OBD-II dongle that runs the firmware.

text.tspan: Turn an ESP32 or Arduino into a scan tool
for K-Line cars, with a web dashboard.
